thread:
Ava Ruiz: Short sync 15min: planning the launch newsletter + countdown drip. Goal: increase webinar signups and benchmark reads while keeping deliverability high. Draft: https://drive.redwood.ai/countdown-drip-v1
Sanjay Patel: Love the countdown idea. A few constraints: suppress enterprise-regulated customers from marketing sends (privacy/legal reason). Also want to avoid sending to customers with sensitive-data flag.
Marta Chen: Agreed. Segmentation plan:
- Webinar-registrants -> reminders (3 msg cadence)
- Engaged non-registrants (opened or clicked 30d) -> 3-touch countdown + webinar invite
- Low-engagers -> condensed 2-touch countdown with benchmark CTA
- Enterprise/regulatory -> exclusion set (manual list)
Include a fallback for unknown region -> NA send window.
Ben Ortiz: Template notes: adding a real-time countdown timer block (JS-based for webmail) where supported, fallback to "X days left" text. Ensure AMP/interactive sections degrade gracefully.
Also include an accessibility alt flow: plain-text-first modules for screen readers.
Leo Novak: Send windows: pick local 10am primary, 4pm backup. For APAC prefer 9am local. Stagger shards by 10m to avoid spikes. Add a send cap: max 1 marketing send per account in 7 days.
Sanjay Patel: SQL snippets for segments (will finalize in sheet):
```
-- engaged
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_engagement_at > now() - interval '30 days' AND email_opt_in = true AND sensitive_data_flag = false AND not_in_enterprise_exclude = true;
-- low-engagers
SELECT user_id FROM users WHERE last_engagement_at <= now() - interval '30 days' AND email_opt_in = true AND sensitive_data_flag = false;
```
Ava Ruiz: Subject line experiments:
A) "Countdown: join our live demo + benchmark"
B) "2 days left 1min demo: cut inference cost"
For low-engagers softer: "See how teams cut LLM serving cost"
Marta Chen: Preheader rules: keep under 80 chars; mention webinar only for cohorts that get webinar CTA. For accessibility: descriptive link text not just "click here".
Ben Ortiz: UTM: utm_medium=email&utm_source=countdown&utm_campaign=countdown_q2. Add header X-Redwood-Mail: countdown-q2. Also ensure DKIM/SPF alignment check before staging.
deliverability-bot: Current reputation flags: NA region healthy, APAC slight ramp-up limits; recommended throttle for APAC first week: 2000 msgs/min. See ops doc: https://ops.redwood.ai/deliverability/limits
Sanjay Patel: Tracking & alerts: dashboard marketing.countdown.v1. KPIs: open 23% (engaged), CTR 4.2%, webinar sign 6% for engaged cohort. Alert if open<12% or bounce rate >0.5%.
Ava Ruiz: Suppress rules: trial_started_at <= 90d, unsubscribed, enterprise_exclude list, and any recent support-critical customers. Also remove recent webinar attendees.
Marta Chen: Copy notes: for countdown emails keep copy tight, include one bench stat, and one concise customer line. Add clear accessible link to watch the benchmark on landing page.
Ben Ortiz: I'll build the HTML template with dynamic countdown block + accessible plaintext variant. ETA: Thursday EOD for staging. Will run a 100-recipient smoke test for each region (NA/EU/APAC).
Leo Novak: I'll provide shard keys and stagger plan. Also adding rate-limit overrides for the first 30m of launch to prevent accidental spikes.
Sanjay Patel: I'll produce final segment exports and exclusion lists by Friday AM. Also will coordinate with Security to pull enterprise-exclude list.
Ava Ruiz: Action items:
- Ben: template + AMP fallback + smoke tests (Thu EOD)
- Sanjay: final SQL & exports (Fri AM)
- Marta: final copy + subject variants (Fri noon)
- Leo: shard & rate plan + overrides (Fri)
- Ava: set dashboard alerts and hold go/no-go Mon AM
Everyone: add test addresses to the drive doc and tag me when tests complete. :eyes: :rocket:
Marta Chen: I'll also produce a short version of the email for accessibility testing and include alt text for images.
deliverability-bot: Reminder: run seed list tests for ISP variety (Gmail, Outlook, Apple) and report deliverability heatmap.
Ben Ortiz: Noted. Will run seeds during smoke and post results in the doc. Tagging @Ava when seeds pass.
Ava Ruiz: Perfect. Let's keep the countdown tight and respectful of inboxes. Thanks team!
